title: AiFallbackResultDocument
description: The try-it AI fallback's result cache (#2062), keyed by the hash of task, prompt version, model, input and output schema, so a preview and its apply share one paid call. recordJson is the GuardedModelRunner's validated record: the model's output for public page text or column headers and shapes, plus token metadata; never a guest's details. expiresAt drives a 30-day TTL policy.
